title: Remove the crypto and TLS facades and the storage guard client from core
goal: Vision: V-9. CEO decision 2026-11-18 (moves A and B, Mandate 84): (A) delete susi-vendor-chacha20poly1305, susi-vendor-tokio-rustls, susi-vendor-x25519-dalek and susi-vendor-rcgen, which nothing in core uses; Susi Commercial Apps owns them (T-CLAUDETRANSPLANT-1). (B) delete susi-config's storage_guard, config_bridge, mcp, mcp_client, workflow_wire, native_path, protocol_json and workload_process; `local-snapshot guard` and the post-publish witness hand the check to `susi-commercial workflow storage-guard`, and say plainly when Susi Commercial Apps is not installed. Lower the complete-socket ceiling to the measured size.

reuse.searched: Susi Commercial Apps crates/susi-dev-workflow/src/storage_audit.rs (native storage audit) and the transplanted facades and bridge (T-CLAUDETRANSPLANT-1). Core forwards to them; no new code beyond the forward.
